_notes: tier ≈ era cap (1=ENT, 2=TOS, 3=TNG, 4=DS9/VOY, 5=Picard, 6=32nd c.). Era start grants every tech two or more tiers below the era's cap tier; the cap tier and the tier below it are left to research; higher tiers stay locked until a later era. unlocks = buildings/modules (mod_<module id>)/abilities ids. Modules in starting_modules need no tech; assimilated_modules are Borg-only and come from assimilation, not research. faction_rules: factions that get tech without research (the Borg assimilate and combine; they never research).

borg.assimilate: Gains any tech, including other factions' faction-only techs, by assimilating a ship, station or colony that has it.
borg.combine: Once the Collective holds every prerequisite of a tech, any Borg command structure combines them into that tech, paid in nanoprobes instead of research.
